messages:
Maya: opened a tiny PR to update audit export docs + add a quick migration note for old SDK users. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501
Jordan: thanks — legal requested we avoid absolute promises about deletion. suggested phrasing: 'data is retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Sam: also flagging that older SDK versions used `retention_days` param. new SDK accepts `retention_policy` string. i can add both the py and curl examples with a short migration snippet.
Priya: please also include a short sentence about redaction on exports (customers can request exports with sensitive fields redacted). don't include internal infra details.
Maya: copy. i'll reword per Jordan, add Priya's redaction note, and include a migration subsection with a diff and compatibility note.
Sam: proposed snippet (will put in PR comment):
```
# Python example (modern SDK)
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-123", retention_policy="audit:90d", redacted=True)
print(resp.url)
```

Older SDK (compat shim):
```
# Older SDK compatibility (migration)
# Before:
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-123", retention_days=90)
# After:
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-123", retention_policy="audit:90d")
```

curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-123","retention_policy":"audit:90d","redacted":true}'
```
Jordan: looks good. legal wants a one-line cross-ref to the SOC2 FAQ and a small caveat: 'exported data may be subject to legal hold or regulatory retention requirements.'
Maya: added the caveat and SOC2 FAQ link in the migration note. also added a PR checklist item: run SDK snippet smoke test in CI.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/501/export-migration-note — preview expires in 7 days. :sparkles:
Priya: re redaction language: "Customers can request redacted exports; sensitive values (tokens, secrets) are removed or masked before delivery." ok to keep at a high level?
Maya: yes — kept high-level, removed any implementation specifics (no S3, no key names).
Sam: small ask — add a short troubleshooting tip: if export URL 403s, check tenant permissions and that export retention matches tenant's compliance settings.
Maya: added troubleshooting note and a tiny changelog entry. requesting final reviews from @Jordan and @Priya before merge.
Jordan: +1 pending final legal pass. will review the PR comment thread shortly.
Maya: thanks all — merging once legal signs off.
